items.title: Product Manager, Learning
items.description: About the Team The ChatGPT product team is a rapidly evolving, high-impact group within OpenAI that builds intuitive, safe, and useful AI-powered experiences for millions of people worldwide. Our team brings together engineering, design, research, and product to explore how conversational AI can help people learn, create, and solve problems. AI has the potential to transform how millions of people learn, teach, and achieve their goals. Learning is one of the top use cases on ChatGPT— not only for students, but also for adults building new skills in a rapidly changing world. The Education team is focused on advancing how humans learn with AI and working to make high-quality learning accessible. We aim to deliver measurable gains in cognition and achievement, partnering closely with students, educators, and country leaders to ensure new tools are safe, effective, and trusted. About the Role As a Product Manager for Education & Learning, you will shape the strategy and build products to advance learning experiences in ChatGPT— defining a category that could reshape classrooms, careers, and lifelong learning. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional partners—from AI research to design to go-to-market—to build ChatGPT into a true learning agent and ensure those products you build meet the needs of stakeholders throughout the ecosystem. You will also partner closely with product teams across growth, youth well-being, and enterprise to ensure alignment and maximize impact. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Define and drive the product vision for education and learning in ChatGPT. - Partner with research teams to explore how AI can better advance learning outcomes - Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including design, engineering, product, and go-to-market—to bring education features to life. - Partner with xfn growth, GTM, and marketing teams to bring the tools to students, adult learners, and educators. - Work with external partners in academia, education, and workforce development to track outcomes & ensure products are safe, effective, and aligned with real-world needs. - Use both data and user feedback to validate impact and guide product direction. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 10+ years of product management experience with strong leadership, xfn collaboration, and communication skills. - Bring experience in education, EdTech, or learning research, or are eager to dive into complex, research-driven problem spaces. - Have built and scaled impactful consumer products. - Are motivated by OpenAI’s mission and excited to build products that help people learn. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. items.title: Engineering Manager, Credit Cards & Banking
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role The Credit Cards & Banking team is part of Robinhood’s Money Engineering organization. This team builds the products and systems behind some of Robinhood’s most ambitious consumer experiences, including Robinhood Gold Credit Card, Banking, and the next generation of card and banking products. This is a high-impact engineering leadership role at the intersection of product innovation, scale, and reliability. Our team owns the full customer experience end to end—from mobile and frontend surfaces to backend systems and the infrastructure that powers them. We work on products used by millions, in a space where execution quality, technical rigor, and customer trust matter deeply. As an Engineering Manager, you’ll lead a team of engineers building category-defining credit card and banking experiences. You’ll partner closely with product, design, data, compliance, operations, and peer engineering teams to define the roadmap, make sound technical decisions, and deliver exceptional products at scale. You’ll also play a central role in hiring, coaching, and developing a high-performing team. We’re looking for bold thinkers, sharp problem-solvers, and leaders who want to help build the future of money. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Lead, grow, and support a team of software engineers working on Robinhood’s Credit Cards & Banking product area Set clear direction for the team across execution, technical design, and people development Partner with product managers, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders to define roadmaps and deliver high-impact customer experiences Drive the architecture, execution, and operational excellence needed to build reliable, scalable card and banking systems Guide engineering decisions across product surfaces, backend services, and platform dependencies Improve team health and effectiveness through strong planning, prioritization, feedback, and career development Hire exceptional engineers and raise the bar on talent, performance, and engineering craftsmanship Help the team move quickly while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, and customer trust What you bring 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams Experience leading teams that build and ship customer-facing products at scale Strong technical judgment and the ability to partner closely on architecture, tradeoffs, and execution Experience working on complex distributed systems, backend services, or full-stack consumer products A track record of driving cross-functional initiatives from concept through launch Experience coaching and developing engineers through regular feedback, performance management, and career growth Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical partner A high bar for execution, product quality, and building strong teams Leadership expectations Our ambitious roadmap requires strong leaders who can build both exceptional products and exceptional teams. We’re looking for someone who can: Drive high performance through clear goals, strong accountability, and fast learning Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar and investing deeply in team development Create clarity in ambiguous, fast-moving environments Build trust across functions and keep teams aligned around customer and business impact Raise the quality of both technical execution and people leadership Bonus points Experience in fintech, banking, credit cards, payments, lending, or other highly regulated domains Experience leading teams through periods of rapid growth, product expansion, or platform scaling Experience building mobile-first or consumer app experiences Familiarity with modern backend and data systems in high-availability environments What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $230,000 — $270,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $203,000 — $238,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $180,000 — $211,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
items.description: MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. The role We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most. Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations. Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements. Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here. Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap. What you’ll do Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network (Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams About you 5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected Bonus points Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!) Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1) Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2) Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3) Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments How we work MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open as a hybrid position from our Berlin, London and New York offices. NYC Salary: $180,000 - $300,000 USD Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Benefits & Perks 💡 💰 Competitive salary package 🤝 Equity package: financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay 📈 Pay-for-performance equity bonus: those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards 🚀 Moonshot award: we honor exceptional impact. 20 employees a year, each earning a $250,000 equity grant 📊Pension: employer contributions from day one 🎁Employee referral program: refer great people, earn 10K in USDC 🏝 Flexible Time Off: choose when to work and when to switch off 🔋Recharge Period: end-of-year company-wide time off to rest and reset 🎂 Birthday leave: take the day off to celebrate you 🍼 Enhanced parental leave: more time with family, no second thought 🌍 Hybrid working schedule: work fully remotely or from your nearest Moonbase 🚆 Commuter benefits: public transport to and from the office 🩺 Private healthcare benefits: to protect you and your loved ones 🧘 Wellhub wellness membership: access to gyms, studios, classes, and wellness apps in one membership 🤖 Enterprise access to the latest AI tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and whatever's next 🍱 Lunch credit: meals covered on the days you're in the office 🪑 Home office setup allowance: build the home office of your dreams 👛 Remote working allowance: those working fully remotely get a little extra for utilities 🌕 Monthly product budget and zero-fee crypto transactions 📚 $1,000 Annual training budget: we support your learning journey 🎯 High Potential Program: structured development, mentorship, and stretch opportunities ✈️ Regular remote company offsites: high-impact in-person sessions and hackathons 🚲 (Ireland) Cycle to Work scheme: tax-efficient bike, gear, and safety kit 🔌 (UK) EV Salary Sacrifice: lease an electric vehicle through pre-tax salary Commitment to Diversity At MoonPay we believe that every voice matters. That's why we are committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and are a proud equal opportunity employer. items.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Sports
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE LeoVegas Group is building a world-class Sportsbook platform. Within the Sports domain, we work in a high-volume, real-time environment where speed, correctness, scalability and reliability are critical, building the services that transform incoming sports, trading and pricing data into experiences used by millions of customers. We are looking for a highly experienced Staff Backend Engineer to help lead the design, development and evolution of these distributed systems. You will provide technical leadership across architecture, engineering practices and platform evolution while remaining hands-on, helping teams make better technical decisions, raise engineering standards, simplify complex systems and balance business needs with long-term platform health. This role suits someone who enjoys understanding the technical and business context behind problems rather than implementing solutions mechanically. We value engineers who are curious and proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and who lead through collaboration and ownership rather than authority. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Lead architecture and design discussions for scalable, resilient and maintainable distributed systems, evaluating options through spikes, experiments and proofs of concept. • Drive simplification of complex systems while holding a high bar for performance, reliability and code quality. • Identify scalability, resiliency and operational risks before they reach production, and lead root cause analysis when incidents occur. • Improve observability, monitoring and operational readiness, and drive down technical debt across the platform. • Promote best practices around event-driven and reactive architectures, performance optimisation, testing, automation and CI/CD. • Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pair programming and technical guidance. • Partner with Product, Engineering Managers and Architects to translate business problems into practical solutions, and help shape and break down technical initiatives. • Contribute to a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and engineering excellence. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ESSENTIAL SKILLS • Proven experience designing, building and operating distributed systems at scale, owning complex backend systems end-to-end in production. • Strong backend expertise in Java (preferably 21+), with a solid understanding of JVM internals, concurrency and multithreading. • Hands-on experience with Reactive Programming and non-blocking systems using Spring Boot and/or Vert.x. • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka and event-driven architectures; familiarity with streaming and messaging technologies such as Redis or NATS. • Experience with Redis for caching and low-latency data access, and with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB). • Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Grafana or Kibana, and with debugging complex production incidents. • Strong system design and architectural decision-making, balancing latency, throughput, consistency, operational complexity and maintainability. • Ability to influence technical decisions and communicate effectively with engineers, architects, product managers and other stakeholders. NICE TO HAVE • Experience with Kubernetes, AWS and/or GCP, and cloud-native architecture patterns. • Experience with OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch for search, analytics and operational troubleshooting. • Experience building internal platforms, shared frameworks or developer productivity tooling, with a strong SRE mindset. • Experience within sports betting, gaming or other real-time, data-intensive domains. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Teams rely on you for technical direction and practical problem-solving, and move faster thanks to the foundations, tooling, standards and guidance you help establish. • The platform becomes more reliable, scalable and easier to operate over time, with fewer production incidents. • Technical decisions are made with greater clarity, consistency and long-term sustainability. • Cross-team dependencies are better coordinated, reducing friction and improving delivery. • Engineers grow technically through your mentorship, feedback and leadership. WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We're a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 21 offices worldwide. WHAT WE OFFER • Competitive salary aligned with your experience, expertise and impact. • A collaborative, inclusive and fast-paced engineering environment where ideas are welcomed, ownership is encouraged and continuous learning is valued. • Hybrid work policy and 4 weeks of Workation (T&Cs apply). • Benefits package - 800 PLN net (B2B)/gross (UOP) monthly with access to the cafeteria platform (private medical care, insurances, sports card). • Training budget and the ICAS assistance programme for support during challenging moments. • Complimentary snacks and drinks in the office, with complimentary breakfast on Mondays. • Team and office social events throughout the year. • Free parking for bicycles and motorcycles, and a free gym in the building. • Equipment: MacBook Pro and smartphone (iPhone 16/17 or Samsung Galaxy S25). JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don't wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we'd like to see your CV in English, please.
